widgets.name: Active window
widgets.description: The window you are working in on this screen, with its application's icon. On another monitor, the window last used there. Click to bring it forward. Needs the window list turned on: rmpr windows enable.

showAppName.label: Name the application instead of the window
showAppName.description: "Dolphin" rather than the folder it has open, as a macOS menu bar does.

widgets.name: Battery
widgets.description: Charge, time left and the power profile. Takes no room on a machine with no battery, so it is safe to leave on a desktop's panel.

showPercentage.label: Show the percentage
showPercentage.description: Beside the icon. The icon alone moves in steps of ten.

widgets.name: Bluetooth
widgets.description: Switches Bluetooth and connects devices already paired. Pairing a new one opens Plasma's own applet. Takes no room where there is no adapter.

widgets.name: Brightness and Night Light
widgets.description: A slider per screen that can be dimmed -- a laptop panel, or a monitor over DDC -- and a switch to suspend Night Light. Scroll to dim every screen at once, middle-click to suspend Night Light.

step.label: Scroll step
step.description: Percent per notch of the wheel.

widgets.name: Clipboard
widgets.description: What you copied, to copy again. Reads Plasma's clipboard history when it is running; when it is not -- under this shell's own renderer -- keeps one itself, text only and in memory.

shown.label: Entries shown
shown.description: How many of the most recent entries the popout lists.

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: Current time and date.

showDate.label: Show date
showDate.description: Under the time; beside it on a thin panel, and not at all down the side of the screen.

format.label: Time format of your own
format.description: A Qt date/time format string, which wins over the choices above. Empty for those.

widgets.name: Divider
widgets.description: A thin line between groups of widgets.

widgets.name: Keyboard layout
widgets.description: Which keyboard layout is on; click for the next one, or scroll through them. Takes no room with only one layout configured.

widgets.name: Application launcher
widgets.description: Opens whichever launcher is configured: Kickoff, KRunner, the built-in one, or a command of your own.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: A Material Symbols name, drawn on the accent tile. Empty draws the theme icon below instead.

icon.label: Theme icon
icon.description: Drawn when the glyph is empty, or where Material Symbols is not installed.

label.label: Label
label.description: Shown beside the icon. Empty for icon only.

widgets.name: Media
widgets.description: What is playing, in any player that speaks MPRIS: middle-click to pause, click for the controls. Takes no room when nothing is open.

showTitle.label: Show the title
showTitle.description: Beside the icon, on a panel along the top or bottom.

widgets.name: Network
widgets.description: What is connected, and a Wi-Fi switch. Joining a network opens Plasma's own applet, which asks for the password.

widgets.name: Notification history
widgets.description: What went past: recent notifications, readable again, and askable with AI assist on.

showCount.label: Count rather than a dot
showCount.description: Something unseen shows as a dot on the bell; on, as the number since the list was last opened.

widgets.name: Session
widgets.description: Opens Plasma's own logout and shutdown prompt.

widgets.name: Camera and microphone in use
widgets.description: Appears while an application records from the camera or a microphone, and names it. Click to mute the microphone. Takes no room the rest of the time.

widgets.name: Search
widgets.description: A search field on the panel. It opens whatever searches for you: KRunner, the built-in launcher, or a command of your own (launcher.searchProvider).

label.label: Label
label.description: The word in the field. Empty for the icon alone; down the side of the screen there is never room for it.

widgets.name: Show desktop
widgets.description: Peeks at the desktop, Windows-style. Sits at the end of the panel.

peek.label: Peek at the desktop
peek.description: Rest the pointer on the strip to move the windows aside until it leaves. A click while peeking keeps the desktop.

widgets.name: Sidebar
widgets.description: Opens this shell's sidebar, which slides in from the right. The same panel Meta+S opens.

widgets.name: Quick settings
widgets.description: Network, Bluetooth, sound and battery in one place on the panel, and quick settings a click away: Wi-Fi and Ethernet, Bluetooth, the microphone, do not disturb, Night Light, and game mode and VPN where there are any, with the volume and the brightness -- each with a page of its own for the devices behind it. Choose which tiles are drawn. Scroll to change the volume, middle-click to mute.

tiles.label: Tiles
tiles.description: Which switches the grid draws, in this order. A tile for hardware the machine does not have is left out whether or not it is on here -- no Bluetooth adapter, no Bluetooth tile.

density.label: Quick settings
density.description: roomy: a grid of tiles. dense: a list of rows, each with its switch.

step.label: Volume step
step.description: Percent per notch of the wheel.

widgets.name: Open windows
widgets.description: The windows you have open, and a click to switch to one. Needs the window list turned on: rmpr windows enable.

groupByApp.label: Group windows by application
groupByApp.description: One button per application, as KDE and Windows do, with a mark per window. Clicking moves through that application's windows.

pinned.label: Pinned applications
pinned.description: Desktop entry ids ("org.kde.dolphin"), kept on the taskbar in this order whether or not they are running. Right-click a button and choose "Pin to taskbar" rather than typing them.

thisScreenOnly.label: Only this screen's windows
thisScreenOnly.description: Each monitor's panel lists the windows on that monitor, as Windows does with "show taskbar apps on the taskbar where the window is open".

thisDesktopOnly.label: Only this desktop's windows
thisDesktopOnly.description: The windows on the virtual desktop in front, as KDE's own task manager and Windows both do. Off lists every window on every desktop. A window set to be on all desktops is always listed.

previewHeader.label: Name the application above its previews
previewHeader.description: The application's icon and name over the window cards, with how many windows it has. Off, each card's own icon and title say it.

previewScreen.label: Name the monitor on each preview
previewScreen.description: With more than one monitor, the one a window is on ("DP-2") after its title. The desktop it is on is said whenever there is more than one.

stackGroups.label: Stack the icon of an application with several windows
stackGroups.description: A second square behind the icon when an application has more than one window open, so the count shows on the button itself.

showTitles.label: Show titles
showTitles.description: The window's title beside its icon, as far as the widest a button gets. Off, buttons are icons alone and the title is one hover away.

iconSize.label: Icon size
iconSize.description: 0 follows the panel's thickness, so resizing the panel resizes the icons with it.

iconScale.label: Icon size, as a share of the button
iconScale.description: How much of a button's height the icon fills, in percent. 100 leaves no room around it; the default leaves a little. Ignored when "Icon size" is set to an exact number of pixels.

widgets.name: Task view
widgets.description: Opens KWin's Overview -- every window and virtual desktop at once, as Windows' task view does.

effect.label: Opens
effect.description: Which of KWin's views: the Overview, the grid of virtual desktops, or the windows of this desktop (Expose) or of all of them (ExposeAll).

widgets.name: System tray
widgets.description: StatusNotifierItem icons from running applications, with the rest behind a chevron.

iconSize.label: Icon size
iconSize.description: 0 follows the panel's tray icon size.

chevron.label: The hidden-icons button sits
chevron.description: after: at the end of the tray, past the icons, as the design has it. before: at the start, so the icons that come and go do not push it around -- which is what Plasma's tray does.

pinned.label: On the panel
pinned.description: StatusNotifierItem ids shown on the panel, in this order. Empty shows every item; pin any and the rest move behind the chevron. Settings has a page that edits this by dragging, which is easier than typing ids.

hidden.label: Never shown
hidden.description: Ids left out altogether, not even behind the chevron.

widgets.name: Volume
widgets.description: The default output's volume. Scroll to change it, middle-click to mute, click for sliders; Plasma's own mixer is one click further.

step.label: Scroll step
step.description: Percent per notch of the wheel.

maxVolume.label: Loudest by scrolling
maxVolume.description: Percent. 0 follows Settings → Sound, where "Raise maximum volume" lives and which every other slider in this shell reads; anything else is this widget's own ceiling.

showMicrophone.label: Show the microphone
showMicrophone.description: A second slider in the popout, for the default input.

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.description: The temperature now, and a forecast when you click it. Off until Settings -> Weather is turned on: it is the one widget that talks to the internet, and it asks Open-Meteo for a place and nothing else.

showTemperature.label: Show the temperature
showTemperature.description: Beside the icon. Off leaves the icon alone, which is narrower on a full panel.

showPlace.label: Show the place
showPlace.description: The town the forecast is for, after the temperature.

days.label: Days shown
days.description: How many days of the forecast the popout lists.

widgets.name: Virtual desktops
widgets.description: Switches between KWin virtual desktops.

style.label: Pills show
style.description: numbers: the desktop's number. icons: the icons of the windows on it. dots: a dot. An empty desktop is always a dot.

maxShown.label: Desktops shown
maxShown.description: At most this many; the current desktop is always among them.
